Human Safety Monitoring ( asimov_human_safety_monitoring_eval.py ) Visualizing Results License Asimov Agentic Safety Evaluation Evaluation harness for testing agentic AI systems on safety-critical robotics tasks. Dataset and code are hosted on Hugging Face: google/asimov_agentic . Quick Start 1. Install Git LFS and clone the repository The dataset files are stored with Git LFS . You must install Git LFS before cloning, otherwise you'll get LFS pointer files instead of the actual data. # Install Git LFS (one-time setup) # macOS: brew install git-lfs # Ubuntu/Debian: # sudo apt-get install git-lfs git lfs install git clone https://huggingface.co/datasets/google/asimov_agentic cd asimov_agentic Troubleshooting: If you already cloned without Git LFS and get ArrowInvalid: Parquet magic bytes not found errors, run both commands inside the repo: git lfs install git lfs pull 2. Create a virtual environment and install dependencies python3 -m venv venv source venv/bin/activate pip install inspect_ai pandas pyarrow pillow numpy google-genai openai anthropic 3. Set your API key # For Google Gemini models: export GOOGLE_API_KEY= "YOUR_GEMINI_API_KEY" # For OpenAI models: export OPENAI_API_KEY= "YOUR_OPENAI_API_KEY" # For Anthropic models: export ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= "YOUR_ANTHROPIC_API_KEY" 4. Run an evaluation python3 asimov_agentic_evals.py \ --task agent_physical_constraints_eval \ --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview \ -- limit 5 The --base_dir defaults to . (the repo root), so the scripts automatically find the Parquet files after cloning. Dataset Structure After cloning, the repository has the following layout: asimov_agentic/ ├── asimov_agentic_evals.py # Single-turn eval tasks ├── asimov_gauge_reading_eval.py # Gauge reading evals ├── asimov_vla_estimator_emulator_eval.py # Closed-loop VLA eval ├── asimov_human_safety_monitoring_eval.py # Human safety monitoring eval ├── asimov_utils.py # Shared utilities ├── README.md ├── constraints/ │ └── physical_constraints.parquet ├── gauge_reading/ │ ├── gauge_can_read_adversarial.parquet │ └── gauge_cannot_read_express_uncertainty.parquet ├── human_safety_monitoring/ │ └── *.parquet (28 episode files) ├── safety_tool_call/ │ └── safety_tool_call_eval.parquet ├── uncertainty/ │ └── agent_uq_with_di.parquet ├── vla_estimator_emulator/ │ └── vla_estimator_emulator.parquet └── vla_feasibility/ └── vla_feasibility_extended_di_vla_protocol.parquet Evaluation Scripts 1. Single-Turn Agentic Tasks ( asimov_agentic_evals.py ) Evaluates agent decision-making on safety-critical single-turn tasks with tool calls. Tasks ( --task ): Task Description agent_physical_constraints_eval Decision-making under physical constraints (payload, reach limits) agent_vla_feasibility_extended_di_vla_protocol_eval VLA feasibility over extended dialogue with tool invocation agent_safety_monitor_eval Safety-critical monitor decisions scored by LLM autorater agent_uq_with_uncertainty_resolution_di_eval Uncertainty quantification and resolution Options: Flag Default Description --task agent_physical_constraints_eval Task to run --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview Model to evaluate --autorater_model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview Autorater for agent_safety_monitor_eval --limit 5 Number of samples (0 = all) --base_dir . Directory containing Parquet subdirectories --inspect_log_dir (none) Directory for Inspect log output Examples: # Physical constraints (Gemini) python3 asimov_agentic_evals.py \ --task agent_physical_constraints_eval \ --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview \ -- limit 0 # Safety monitor with autorater (OpenAI) OPENAI_API_KEY= "..." python3 asimov_agentic_evals.py \ --task agent_safety_monitor_eval \ --model openai/gpt-5.5 \ --autorater_model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview \ -- limit 0 # VLA feasibility (Anthropic) ANTHROPIC_API_KEY= "..." python3 asimov_agentic_evals.py \ --task agent_vla_feasibility_extended_di_vla_protocol_eval \ --model anthropic/claude-opus-4-8 \ -- limit 0 2. Gauge Reading ( asimov_gauge_reading_eval.py ) Evaluates gauge reading accuracy under adversarial conditions and uncertainty expression. Tasks ( --task ): Task Description agent_gauge_can_read_adversarial_attacks Gauge reading under glare, blur, occlusion agent_gauge_can_not_read_express_uncertainty Detecting unreadable gauges, expressing uncertainty Examples: # Adversarial gauge reading python3 asimov_gauge_reading_eval.py \ --task agent_gauge_can_read_adversarial_attacks \ --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview \ -- limit 0 # Uncertainty expression python3 asimov_gauge_reading_eval.py \ --task agent_gauge_can_not_read_express_uncertainty \ --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview \ -- limit 0 3. Closed-Loop VLA Estimator Emulator ( asimov_vla_estimator_emulator_eval.py ) Evaluates agentic subtask planning and execution in a closed-loop simulation with tool calls, success probability estimation, and safety compliance. Options: Flag Default Description --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview Model to evaluate --limit 5 Number of samples (0 = all) --base_dir . Directory containing Parquet subdirectories --oracle_image_only False Use image-only oracle (no ground truth instruction) --inspect_log_dir (none) Directory for Inspect log output Example: python3 asimov_vla_estimator_emulator_eval.py \ --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview \ -- limit 5 4. Human Safety Monitoring ( asimov_human_safety_monitoring_eval.py ) Evaluates human proximity detection from stereo camera images for robot safety. Protocols: Protocol Description tool_use Agent calls stop_robot() or continue() based on distance threshold json_pred Agent outputs JSON with distance estimate and proximity indicators Options: Flag Default Description --protocol tool_use Evaluation protocol --tool_use_threshold 3.0 Distance threshold (meters) for tool_use --timestamp_step 5 Evaluate every N seconds --single_frame False Use single stereo pair instead of temporal history --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview Model to evaluate --limit 5 Number of samples (0 = all) --base_dir . Directory containing Parquet subdirectories --inspect_log_dir (none) Directory for Inspect log output Examples: # Tool use protocol (3m threshold) python3 asimov_human_safety_monitoring_eval.py \ --protocol tool_use \ --tool_use_threshold 3.0 \ --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview \ -- limit 5 # JSON distance prediction python3 asimov_human_safety_monitoring_eval.py \ --protocol json_pred \ --model google/gemini-robotics-er-1.6-preview \ -- limit 5 Visualizing Results After running evaluations, use the Inspect AI web UI to browse results: inspect view --log-dir logs Opens at http://localhost:3000 by default. Use --port 8000 for a custom port. License This project is licensed under the MIT License.
